entities.summary: Vladimir Gligorov was a Macedonian and Yugoslav economist, political analyst and liberal public intellectual. He was a member of the Founding Committee of the Democratic Party in Serbia in December 1989. He was the son of the first President of the Republic of Macedonia, Kiro Gligorov.
